notes: No model has been called under protocol v2. Owner fills provider, model, prompt_version, parser_version, prediction_schema_version, parameters, and approval before the first call. The runner refuses any non-mock v2 run until approval.owner and approval.approved_utc are set, approval.pilot_approved (pilot) or approval.full_approved (full) is true, and provider/model match the run.
The pilot runs only after approval and stops at its cap; the full run needs a second approval and must not exceed full_new_calls_after_pilot new calls.
V2 results are reported separately from v1 and never replace the frozen v1 result files.

2026-10-26: owner chose Claude Haiku 4.5 (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) via the Claude Code CLI because gpt-5.4-mini is no longer served by the Codex CLI. Prompt v1 (mark_id selection) and parser v1 keep the v1 paired design; the historical v3a Haiku 4.5 run used prompt v2 and scored 100/100 raw, so a ceiling result is possible. Approval block stays null until the owner approves the 20-call pilot.

pilot.selection_rule: For target index t in 0..9 (frozen TARGET_SPECS order) select the unique v2 example with screen_state_index = t mod 5 and task_seed = t - (t mod 5). The crossed allocation target_index = (task_seed + screen_state_index) mod 10 then yields target t, so the pilot covers all 10 targets once, every screen state exactly twice, and seeds 0 and 5 only. Selection is independent of JSONL row order.
